title: Considerations for Converting Single-sex Schools to Co-ed Schools and for Relocating Schools
what_it_is: Considerations for Converting Single-sex Schools to Co-ed Schools and for Relocating Schools

sections.label: Tengah school site and co-ed
sections.summary: MOE offered ACS a Tengah site, said girls must be taken in there, and will give advance notice of major school changes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: In the course of these discussions, MOE offered a Tengah school site to the ACS Board of Governors (BOG), but explained that it would not be tenable for the school not to take in girls at its Tengah location as that would constrain school options for families in the area.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: MOE does not have a plan to proactively convert existing single-gender schools to co-ed schools, but we have had several such cases over the decades.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Where there are major changes for schools, including relocation and turning co-ed, MOE will give advance notice as far ahead as possible once plans are firmed up, and will work with the schools on transition arrangements to minimise impact and inconvenience for existing students and their families.

sections.label: Single-gender schools turning co-ed
sections.summary: Several single-gender schools have turned co-ed in recent years, possibly with relocation, including Canossa Catholic Primary, De La Salle, St Anthony's Primary, Geylang Methodist Primary and Fairfield Methodist Primary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Having said that, there have also been a number of single-gender schools that have turned co-ed, which may or may not involve relocation in recent years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: These include Canossa Catholic Primary School, De La Salle School, St Anthony's Primary, Geylang Methodist Primary, Fairfield Methodist Primary.

sections.label: Site return and ACS consultation
sections.summary: The site returns to the state after 2039, and the ACS board consulted stakeholders within a tight circle due to property market price sensitivities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Yes, so from now to 2039, we have a good 15 to 16 years to go.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: So, after 2039, the site will be returned to the state.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: On the other question on whether the ACS board consulted its stakeholders, I think the ACS board did consult the relevant stakeholders but it had to keep it to within a tight circle, given some of the sensitivities with this move, particularly, price sensitivities related to the property market.

sections.label: Positive feedback on new schools
sections.summary: Since the announcement, ground feedback has generally been positive, especially for West residents gaining new school options including ACS in Tengah.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chan Chun Sing
sentences.text: Since the announcement has been made, I think our ground feedback has generally been positive, particularly for the people staying in the West to have the added options of the new schools, including ACS in Tengah.
